findings.title: New table visualization is rendered with permanently empty data
findings.body: When the 'use-table-widget-visualization' feature is enabled, tableResultComponent renders TableWidgetVisualization with columns=[] and a hard-coded tableData of data: [] and empty meta, instead of converting result.data/result.meta and the widget fields into tabular data. Every dashboard table widget for an organization with the flag enabled will therefore render an empty table regardless of the query results.

findings.title: Reports with neither age nor timestamp, or with age=0 plus timestamp, pass validation
findings.body: Both age and timestamp are declared required=False, so a report containing neither field is accepted even though each supported Reporting API format supplies exactly one of them. The cross-field validators also use truthiness (self.initial_data.get('age') / get('timestamp')), so a report with age=0 and a timestamp present passes despite the stated mutual-exclusion rule. The endpoint will count malformed reports as valid browser reports.

findings.title: Hidden span attributes are only hidden while searching
findings.body: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES ('is_segment', 'project_id', 'received') is only applied inside the branch that runs when searchQuery is non-empty. With no search text the function returns sortAttributes(attributes) unfiltered, so the supposedly hidden internal attributes are still displayed in the Attributes section; the filter needs to be applied before/independently of the search-text filter.

findings.title: Error events are ordered against segment timestamps using mismatched units
findings.body: fetch_error_details takes 'timestamp' from the stored error event, which is an epoch value in seconds, while replay recording segment events carry rrweb timestamps in milliseconds. gen_request_data compares error_events[error_idx]['timestamp'] < event.get('timestamp', 0) directly, so in production every error (approx. 1.7e9) sorts before every segment event (approx. 1.7e12) and all errors are emitted at the start of the log stream regardless of when they occurred, corrupting the chronological context sent to Seer. The unit test masks this by using second-scale segment timestamps (1.5/2.0/3.0).

findings.title: Assemble analytics event is recorded before feature-flag and validation checks
findings.body: analytics.record('preprod_artifact.api.assemble', ...) runs unconditionally at the start of post(), before the 'organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble' feature check returns 404 and before request-body validation returns 400. Calls from organizations without the feature and malformed requests are therefore counted as assemble API usage, skewing adoption/usage analytics for the new event type.
